creator: OpenAI image generation, requested by repository owner
prompt:
Create a SINGLE polished square app icon for the independent Steam Deck plugin "deckystream", using the attached brand direction board as the exact reference. The owner loves the top banner's luminous sculptural aqua-to-violet logo and wants THAT appearance for the app icon, rather than the flat teal icon shown at the bottom of the board.

Use ONLY the emblem from the TOP RIGHT HERO BANNER: the original circular orbital stream symbol, a nearly closed circular ribbon/ring with its intentional gap at the upper right and a flowing S-shaped band through its center. Preserve its exact silhouette, proportions, direction, negative space and smooth continuous anatomy as closely as possible. Do not redesign the symbol, add a play triangle, add a controller, change the shape into a letter typed with a font, or introduce any third-party logo.

Render that same emblem centered and large, occupying about 72 percent of the square width, with ample comfortable padding. Use the gorgeous HERO BANNER material: luminous frosted aqua glass, subtle dimensional bevels, soft highlights, restrained turquoise glow, with the lavender/violet transition concentrated on the upper-right and right-hand portion. The luminous gradient must be visible across the symbol; it must not be a flat solid color. Avoid an overexposed white logo. Smooth professional premium app-icon finish, crisp silhouette, beautiful controlled light.

Background: full-bleed opaque midnight ink / near-black (#080E13) square, with a very quiet aqua/violet ambient halo behind the emblem. Background reaches every edge; do not bake rounded-square outer corners into the canvas. No separate app tile mockup, no outer frame, no device, no text, no tagline, no labels, no palette swatches, no multiple variants. No water, floor, horizon, orbit construction lines or tiny stars, because this must work as an actual app/avatar icon. The finished image must be one usable square icon, not a presentation sheet.

Retain the identity and icy aqua/violet palette of the original banner, translated directly into a simple premium icon.

referencedImages.use: Preserve the top-right banner emblem and aqua/violet treatment; replace the board's flat teal icon treatment.
